reconciliation.ownership_rule: Every live definition appears exactly once; category families are assigned to the formal NW-T3-01 through NW-T3-19 slice that owns the behavior.
reconciliation.evidence_boundary: PASS is slice-level and evidence-scoped. Tier 4/5 profile, export, compiler, worker-concurrency and accessibility campaigns remain separate.
